new.name: apply_leased
new.source:
fn apply_leased(sim : LeasedSimulator, workflow : LeasedWorkflow, command : LeasedCommand) : Result((LeasedSimulator, CommandResult), String) =
  match command of
    LStart(id) =>
      let started = new_run(sim, workflow, id)?
      Ok((started, RNull))
    LAdvance(by) =>
      if sim.now + by > time_limit() then Err("TIME_OVERFLOW")
      else Ok((LeasedSimulator { ..sim, now = sim.now + by }, RNull))
    LObserve => Ok((sim, RSnapshot(leased_snapshot(sim))))
    LCrash(worker) =>
      let w = require_worker(sim, worker)?
      if not(w.up) then Err("WORKER_DOWN") else Ok((set_worker(sim, worker, false), RNull))
    LRestart(worker) =>
      let w = require_worker(sim, worker)?
      if w.up then Err("WORKER_UP") else Ok((set_worker(sim, worker, true), RNull))
    LClaim(worker) => claim(sim, workflow, worker)
    LRenew(worker, id) => renew(sim, workflow, worker, id)
    LCall(worker, id) => call(sim, workflow, worker, id)
    LDeliver(id) => deliver(sim, workflow, id)
    LCancel(id) =>
      match find_run(sim, id) of
        None => Err("UNKNOWN_RUN")
        Some(run) => Ok((cancel(sim, run), RNull))

new.name: current_live

new.source:
fn deliver(sim : LeasedSimulator, workflow : LeasedWorkflow, id : Int) : Result((LeasedSimulator, CommandResult), String) =
  match find_ticket(sim, id) of
    None => Err("UNKNOWN_TICKET")
    Some(ticket) =>
      match ticket.response of
        None => Ok((sim, RCommitted(false)))
        Some(outcome) =>
          if ticket.delivered || not(current_live(sim, ticket)) || not(worker_up(sim, ticket.worker)) then
            Ok((sim, RCommitted(false)))
          else
            match ticket_step(sim, ticket) of
              None => Ok((sim, RCommitted(false)))
              Some(pair) =>
                let cleared = StepState { ..snd(pair), lease = None }
                let committed = commit(sim, workflow, fst(pair), cleared, ticket.kind, outcome)?
                let updated = replace_ticket(replace_run(sim, committed), Ticket { ..ticket, delivered = true })
                Ok((updated, RCommitted(true)))

  match step.lease of
    Some(l) => if step.status == Running then StepState { ..step, lease = Some(Lease { ..l, expires = now }) } else step

fn run_leased(sim : LeasedSimulator, workflow : LeasedWorkflow, commands : List(LeasedCommand)) : Result(LeasedSimulator, String) =
  match commands of
    Nil => Ok(sim)
    Cons(command, rest) =>
      let step = apply_leased(sim, workflow, command)?
      let next = fst(step)
      run_leased(LeasedSimulator { ..next, results = append(next.results, [snd(step)]) }, workflow, rest)

new.source:
fn execute_as(service : MockService, worker : Option(String), ticket : Option(Int), key : ActionKey, amount : Int, attempt : Int, failures : Int) : (MockService, CallOutcome) =
  if has_effect(service, key) then
    (audit(service, worker, ticket, ExecuteCall, key, attempt, Replayed), Replayed)
  elif transient_count(service, key) < failures then
    (audit(service, worker, ticket, ExecuteCall, key, attempt, Transient), Transient)
  else
    let applied = MockService { ..service, effects = append(service.effects, [Effect { key = key, amount = amount }]) }
    (audit(applied, worker, ticket, ExecuteCall, key, attempt, Applied), Applied)

new.source:
fn parse_leased_command(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedCommand, String) =
  match raw of
    JObj(pairs) =>
      match get_field(pairs, "op") of
        JStr(op) =>
          if op == "start" || op == "cancel" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "run"], [])?
            let id = identifier(get_field(obj, "run"))?
            Ok(if op == "start" then LStart(id) else LCancel(id))
          elif op == "advance" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "by"], [])?
            let by = integer(get_field(obj, "by"), 0, time_limit())?
            Ok(LAdvance(by))
          elif op == "observe" then
            let _ = fields(raw, ["op"], [])?
            Ok(LObserve)
          elif op == "crash" || op == "restart" || op == "claim" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            Ok(if op == "crash" then LCrash(worker) elif op == "restart" then LRestart(worker) else LClaim(worker))
          elif op == "renew" || op == "call" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "worker", "ticket"], [])?
            let worker = identifier(get_field(obj, "worker"))?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(if op == "renew" then LRenew(worker, ticket) else LCall(worker, ticket))
          elif op == "deliver" then
            let obj = fields(raw, ["op", "ticket"], [])?
            let ticket = integer(get_field(obj, "ticket"), 1, time_limit())?
            Ok(LDeliver(ticket))
          else Err("INVALID_INPUT")
        _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")

fn parse_leased_commands(xs : List(Json)) : Result(List(LeasedCommand), String) =
  match xs of
    Nil => Ok(Nil)
    Cons(x, rest) =>
      let command = parse_leased_command(x)?
      let commands = parse_leased_commands(rest)?
      Ok(Cons(command, commands))

new.name: parse_leased_workflow
new.source:
fn parse_leased_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(LeasedWorkflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands", "workers"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay", "lease_duration"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let _ = ensure(length(raw_commands) <= 2000, "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_workers = array(get_field(obj, "workers"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_workers)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let workers = parse_ids(raw_workers)?
  let _ = ensure(unique(workers), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_leased_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  let lease = integer(optional_field(obj, "lease_duration", JInt(5)), 1, 1000000)?
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(LeasedWorkflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, workers = workers,
    max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay, lease_duration = lease })

fn parse_legacy_workflow(raw : Json) : Result(Workflow, String) =
  let obj = fields(raw, ["steps", "commands"], ["max_attempts", "retry_delay"])?
  let raw_steps = array(get_field(obj, "steps"))?
  let _ = ensure(not(is_nil(raw_steps)), "INVALID_INPUT")?
  let raw_commands = array(get_field(obj, "commands"))?
  let steps = parse_steps(raw_steps)?
  let commands = parse_commands(raw_commands)?
  let attempts = integer(optional_field(obj, "max_attempts", JInt(3)), 1, 10)?
  let delay = integer(optional_field(obj, "retry_delay", JInt(2)), 1, 1000000)?
  -- No runtime work occurs until every shape/scalar and then the graph is validated.
  let _ = validate_graph(steps)?
  Ok(Workflow { steps = steps, commands = commands, max_attempts = attempts, retry_delay = delay })

    JObj(pairs) =>

fn handle_request(line : String) : Result(Outcome, String) =
  let request = map_err(\(_) -> "INVALID_INPUT", decode_lossy(line))?
  match request of
    JObj(fields) =>
      let workflow = parse_workflow(get_field(fields, "input"))?
      match workflow of
        Legacy(legacy) =>
          let sim = simulate(legacy)?
          Ok(LegacyOutcome(sim))
        Leased(leased) =>
          let sim = simulate_leased(leased)?
          Ok(LeasedOutcome(sim))
    _ => Err("INVALID_INPUT")
